point_types.press: push button on a service panel; actuates when the tool tip is pushed about 1 cm past its face (jaws closed)
point_types.indicator: status lamp on a service panel: red = unit faulted, green = nominal
point_types.place: surface point where an object can be set down

grasp_interface.contact_region: slot on the narrow neck, between the transverse head above and the collar below
grasp_interface.engagement: fingers close on opposite sides of the neck and sit in the slot; the head above supports the lifted load and the collar below stops the fingers dropping, so the load cannot roll out of the jaws
grasp_interface.release_constraint: below_overhang: after opening, withdraw sideways below the head before lifting clear
grasp_interface.carry_constraint: the head is the upper stop and the collar the lower one, so the fingers are captive in the slot: a roll about the approach axis has to lift one finger out of it and press the other into it, and both are stopped within (neck_height - the fingers' own height)/2. Against a twist about the neck's upright axis there is still only friction on a flat rectangle -- turned by phi the neck presents neck_thickness*cos(phi) + neck_width*sin(phi) to jaws closed on its thickness
grasp_interface.how_it_is_found: the pick skill fits this interface's declared shape to its wrist depth image; you name the item, not the contact
grasp_interface.evidence_requirement: catalogue geometry does not locate the interface; the pick reports how much of the shape the picture agreed with
